note: git -U0 reports a pure insertion as the old line it was inserted AFTER; without this, every line at an insertion point mapped one row late and the eval showed dozens of phantom drifts

lines: if (l < h.oldStart || (h.oldLen === 0 && l === h.oldStart)) return { kind: "same", lines: [l + delta] };
before: // A pure insertion reports the old line it was inserted *after*, so that line is untouched.
